purpose: Define a provider-neutral boundary between a validated internal marketing job and an owner-configured AI runner.

adapterSemantics.disabled: Prepare a validated manifest and stop without making it available to a runner.
adapterSemantics.mock: Exercise the contract with synthetic data only; no external model or credential is used.
adapterSemantics.owner_configured: Delegate to a separately configured owner runtime without placing credentials in this repository or work order.
adapterSemantics.coding_agent_handoff: Make a tenant-scoped work order available to a user-initiated Coding Agent session. This mode does not implement or promise headless subscription authentication.

hardStops: The runner may not receive credentials through this framework repository.
The coding_agent_handoff adapter may not request an LLM API key or extract, copy, emulate, or promise headless use of a Coding Agent subscription credential.
The runner may not publish, schedule, send, contact people, create a campaign, upload an audience, spend money, or modify a product.
The runner may not write a final approval or external-execution receipt.
The assigned lead agent may not create, impersonate, or self-attest the independent quality_assurance verdict.
A tenant must remain isolated; only approved aggregate LearningExport records may cross tenant boundaries.
